caption:
No broker API blocks trading outright. The re-fire loop squares it off.

Because no broker-level block trading API exists except at Dhan, enforcement relies on a server-side re-fire loop. When your account is in a locked state, any new trading activity is squared off within seconds rather than prevented outright.
